dedupe_keys.name: exposure and fragility of a virtual oil refinery testbed for seismic risk assessment

description: This data set offers a virtual mid-size oil refinery, placed in a high-seismicity region of Greece, as a testbed for developing and testing system-level seismic risk assessment methods. It was published on Zenodo in June 2024 by Vasileios Melissianos, Nikolaos Karaferis, Konstantinos Bakalis, Athanasia Kazantzi and Dimitrios Vamvatsikos. It contains a full geolocated exposure model of the critical assets, namely storage tanks, pressure vessels, process towers, chimneys, equipment-supporting buildings and a flare, and for each asset the record-by-record demands and summarised fragility curves derived from nonlinear dynamic analyses of reduced-order numerical models. Spreadsheets per structural type give geometry, modal analysis, damage states with their capacity checks, incremental dynamic analysis results for two intensity measures (peak ground acceleration and average spectral acceleration) and fragility parameters. Coverage is one virtual refinery in Greece. Files are Excel workbooks, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the refinery is virtual, so results illustrate methods, not a real plant. Simulation uses are seismic risk and loss assessment of refineries and industrial plants, and testing system-level and cascading failure methods. Related records: data-southeast-east-asia-power-grid-vulnerability-database gives fragility curves for power grid assets.
